_comment: Weekly side quests ('chatter' at the Saloon). Each week a settlement with a Saloon rolls quests from these templates (count and loot quality come from the Saloon's chatter and tips upgrade tracks). A quest borrows its look, events and curios from the region west of the settlement, plus its own theme events (events: drawn 40%, see quest_event_weights) and scales to that region's tier. fights/elites are weighted groups; final is the group at the end when there is no boss; boss is the mini-boss group (a boss appears with boss_chance). {place} in names and text is replaced with a random place.

plans_doctor.name: The Travelling Surgeon
plans_doctor.desc: Road agents took Doc Pruitt's medicine wagon at {place}, bone saw, diploma and all. Bring it back and the doc will hang a shingle in your town.

boss.name: The Road Agents
boss.intro: The doc's wagon sits behind a ring of road agents at {place}, its painted sign half scraped off. "Finders keepers, friend."
boss.victory: Doc Pruitt's wagon rolls home behind yours, and the doc with it, counting bottles. "Find me a plot and I'll take it from there." You can build a Doctor's Office now.

plans_drill_hall.name: The Old Army Post
plans_drill_hall.desc: Deserters are squatting in the old cavalry post at {place}. The drill manuals are still in the quartermaster's office, and the Territory wants the post cleared.

boss.name: The Deserters
boss.intro: Torn guidons over the gate at {place}. A man in a sergeant's coat with the stripes cut off steps out. "Army forgot this place. So did we."
boss.victory: In the quartermaster's office: a crate of drill manuals, a sword with a broken tip, and the post's old floor plans. You can build a Drill Hall now.

plans_mine.name: The Assay Papers
plans_mine.desc: An old assayer swears there's an iron seam in the hill behind your town, and the survey papers are in his cabin at {place}. Claim jumpers got there first.

boss.name: The Railroad's Men
boss.intro: Fresh stakes all around the assayer's cabin at {place}, company men in long coats behind them, and a claim jumper with a lit fuse in his teeth. "The railroad bought this seam. Papers say it's ours now."
boss.victory: The survey papers are in a coffee can under the cabin floor: a seam of good iron, mapped and stamped. You can build an Iron Mine now.

wanderer_1.name: A Stranger's Challenge
wanderer_1.desc: A note behind the bar, pinned under a silver dollar: "{place}. Noon. Come alone or don't come." The Lone Wanderer wants a rematch, or a first match.

boss.name: The Lone Wanderer
boss.intro: {place} at noon. The wanderer leans on the well with their hat low, as if they've been waiting all week. "Thought you might not show. Pick your best."
boss.victory: The wanderer looks at the hole in their hat brim and laughs. "Fair's fair." They flip you a purse and ride off west. "Next time I won't go easy."
boss.lose: The wanderer's shot kicks the dust between your boots. "Not today." They tip their hat and ride off. The note will be back on the table.

wanderer_2.name: The Wanderer's Trail
wanderer_2.desc: Another note, another dollar: "Ghost town at {place}. Bring the same one." Folks at the bar say the wanderer once rode with Crane, and left him.

boss.name: The Lone Wanderer
boss.intro: Tumbleweeds through an empty main street at {place}. The wanderer stands where the saloon doors used to be. "Crane offered me a cut once. Told him I don't shoot for anyone but me." A long pause. "Draw."
boss.victory: The wanderer's pistol spins out of their hand and into a water trough. They fish it out, grinning. "One more. Somewhere it matters."
boss.lose: Your hero's hat goes flying. The wanderer's already holstered. "Closer. Not close enough."

wanderer_3.name: High Noon at {place}
wanderer_3.desc: No note this time, only the silver dollar, shot clean through the middle. Everyone at the Saloon knows where: {place}, where the wanderer buried the last one who beat them.

boss.name: The Lone Wanderer
boss.intro: A single grave at {place}, the marker bleached white. The wanderer stands beside it. "Last one who beat me is under there. Died of old age, mind you." They step back twenty paces. "Let's settle it."
boss.victory: The wanderer's dollar spins in the air and your hero's bullet goes through it. For a while neither of you says anything. Then the wanderer laughs, the first real laugh you've heard from them. "Keep it. You earned the hole." They ride west, and this time they don't say next time.
boss.lose: The wanderer's bullet clips your hero's holster. "Almost." They sit down by the grave and roll a cigarette. "I'll be here."

mad_dog.name: Mad Dog's Hideout
mad_dog.desc: Ma Delaney hears Mulligan, Silas Crane's enforcer, is holed up at {place} with his brawlers. The whole saloon wants him gone.

boss.name: "Mad Dog" Mulligan
boss.intro:
Mulligan's hideout at {place} is a sod house with a whiskey barrel for a front door. A man the size of a woodstove steps out, cracking his knuckles, a black crow feather stuck in his cap.

"You're the ones who roughed up Pete. Boys! Company!"
boss.victory: Mulligan goes down like a felled oak. When he comes to, he's hog-tied on the back of your wagon, and Ma Delaney has a Wanted poster with a reward on it.

rustlers.name: Rustlers at {place}
rustlers.desc: A rancher says rustlers are holed up at {place} with half his herd.

boss.name: The Rustler Boss
boss.intro: The rustlers' boss stands on a water barrel at {place}, a stolen brand still smoking in his hand. "Nobody told you this is my land now?"
boss.victory: The rustlers scatter into the brush, leaving the herd and everything they stole.

wolf_den.name: The Wolves of {place}
wolf_den.desc: Homesteaders near {place} are losing stock to a wolf pack that isn't afraid of anything.

boss.name: The Pack at the Den
boss.intro: The den is a cut bank at {place}, littered with bones. The whole pack comes out at once, and the biggest wolf you've ever seen leads them.
boss.victory: The pack breaks and runs. The homesteaders at {place} will sleep tonight.

haunted_homestead.name: The Haint at {place}
haunted_homestead.desc: Lights have been seen at the empty homestead at {place}. Folks say the family never left.

boss.name: The Family That Stayed
boss.intro: The door of the homestead at {place} swings open by itself. There's a table set for supper, and the family is sitting at it. They turn to look at you.
boss.victory: The lights go out one by one. Whatever held them here has let go.

claim_jumpers.name: Claim Jumpers at {place}
claim_jumpers.desc: A prospector's claim at {place} was jumped. He'll share the color if you run them off.

boss.name: The Jumpers' Foreman
boss.intro: Sticks of dynamite are stacked in the sluice at {place}, and the man guarding them is holding a lit cigar.
boss.victory: The claim at {place} is back in honest hands, and the prospector pays in color.

snake_gulch.name: Snakes in {place}
snake_gulch.desc: A wagon went into the gulch at {place} and nobody wants to go get it. Snakes.

boss.name: The Nest
boss.intro: The wagon at the bottom of {place} is alive with snakes, and something much bigger is coiled in the bed.
boss.victory: The gulch goes quiet. The wagon's cargo is still there, mostly.

crow_scouts.name: Crane's Scouts near {place}
crow_scouts.desc: Riders with black feathers have been seen watching the road from {place}. Silas Crane is keeping an eye on you.

boss.name: Crane's Scout Captain
boss.intro: The scouts' camp at {place} has a cage full of crows and a map of your whole trail pinned to a tree.
boss.victory: You burn the map and let the crows go. Silas will be a little blinder for a while.
